_readme: Copy this file to trade-queries.json and edit it. Run: node scripts/trade-prices.mjs
Each entry re-runs a search you built on pathofexile.com/trade, so the query is
yours: narrow it however you would to price-check the item by hand. For a veiled
or unidentified drop that usually means setting Identified: No, picking the exact
base, and adding the specific veiled mod.
priceKey is how the site looks the price up:
"Cinderswallow Urn|Life"     one specific roll variant of it
The part after | is matched loosely against the drop line's own variant, so the
label "Veiled Cinderswallow Urn (Life)" in bossData.js finds "...|Life".
Trade search URLs go stale between leagues — the query id is tied to the league
in the URL. At league start, rebuild the searches and paste the new URLs.
Set "skip": true on an entry to leave it out without deleting it.
